items.title: SpaceX exec says she'll donate 2 million shares to kids from low-income families. See who's eligible.
items.summary: Children ages 11 to 17 who live in zip codes with median family incomes of $57,000 or less are among those who qualify for the SpaceX shares.
items.titleZh: SpaceX高管表示，她将向低收入家庭的孩子捐赠200万股。看看谁有资格。
items.summaryZh: 居住在邮政编码区、家庭收入中位数为57000美元或更低的11至17岁儿童有资格获得SpaceX的股份。

items.title: AI boom hits a wall on Wall Street as OpenAI cuts fundraising target while Meta gets a credit warning over its cash flow, spending and monetization
items.summary: S&P Global cut its outlook on Meta to "negative" from "stable" late Friday.
items.titleZh: 人工智能热潮在华尔街遭遇挫折，OpenAI削减了筹资目标，而Meta则因其现金流、支出和货币化而受到信用警告
items.summaryZh: 周五晚些时候，标普全球将Meta的前景从“稳定”下调至“负面”。

items.title: Binance Hack: Everything You Need to Know About the Biggest Crypto Heist in History
items.summary: Attackers tied to North Korea drained roughly $6.4 billion from the world’s largest crypto exchange. Here’s what we know about how it happened, who’s behind it, and what comes next.
items.titleZh: 币安黑客：关于历史上最大的加密货币失窃，你需要知道的一切
items.summaryZh: 与朝鲜有关的攻击者从世界上最大的加密货币交易所窃取了大约64亿美元。以下是我们对它是如何发生的、幕后主使是谁以及接下来会发生什么的了解。

items.title: US forces in Europe are bracing for 'Ukraine's worst day.' AI could help them fight an overwhelming flood of missiles and drones.
items.summary: US forces in Europe are preparing to defend against massive missile and drone attacks while launching strikes of their own on a scale seen in Ukraine.
items.titleZh: 驻欧美军正在为乌克兰最糟糕的一天做准备。“人工智能可以帮助他们对抗大量的导弹和无人机。
items.summaryZh: 驻欧洲的美军正准备防御大规模导弹和无人机袭击，同时发动乌克兰规模的袭击。

items.title: From Karl Marx’s vampire to Warren Buffett’s moat, the crumbling gothic castle has been capitalism’s favorite metaphor for 250 years
items.summary: Jamie Dimon’s “fortress” and Warren Buffett’s “moat” come from the same place as Dracula’s castle, and this week AI put both to the test.
items.titleZh: 从卡尔·马克思的吸血鬼到沃伦·巴菲特的护城河，这座摇摇欲坠的哥特式城堡250年来一直是资本主义最喜欢的比喻
items.summaryZh: 杰米·戴蒙的“堡垒”和沃伦·巴菲特的“护城河”与德古拉的城堡来自同一个地方，本周人工智能对两者进行了测试。

items.title: Anthropic's path to the Nasdaq just got a lot bumpier
items.summary: Concerning projections from hyperscalers this week punished tech stocks and pushed the Nasdaq to its first three-week losing streak since March.
items.titleZh: Anthropic通往纳斯达克的道路变得更加坎坷
items.summaryZh: 本周，超大规模投资者的预测惩罚了科技股，并推动纳斯达克指数自3月以来首次连续三周下跌。
